$comment: Repo-tracked Floodgate release-readiness gate. See docs/adr/003-floodgate-release-readiness.md and ADR-004. This file is read by floodgate-readiness.ts/.test.ts, which fail the build if it drifts from reality without a deliberate update.
notes: expectedOutstandingTodoCount must equal the number of `it.todo(` calls required by Floodgate-direct; todos tagged `[levee-proxy target]` are excluded. verifiedLiveStorageBackends records completed full live Routerlicious runs and must contain every requiredLiveStorageBackends entry before readyForFloodgateRelease can be true. The ETS and actor-memory executable variants passed the full live suite on 2026-07-13. Levee remains a supported independent stack.
